context.body: The bounded canonical source is Daniel 9:3–19; its local speaker, audience, sequence, and literary form remain controlling evidence.

observations.body: Daniel prays with fasting, confesses in the first-person plural, names covenant mercy and persistent disobedience, recalls the exodus, and asks for anger to turn from Jerusalem.
observations.label: Daniel confesses Israel’s sin while asking for Jerusalem: action

observations.body: appeal rests on mercy, not righteousness.
observations.label: Daniel confesses Israel’s sin while asking for Jerusalem: response

payload.posture: Read Daniel 9:3–19 as exile, memory, and return evidence before carrying it into another source.
payload.tension: A faithful individual identifies with communal guilt across generations without claiming personal participation in every act.
payload.title: Daniel confesses Israel’s sin while asking for Jerusalem
